verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk registry extracts or datasets is a fair question for a state business registry, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-entity search, single filing PDFs, a campaign-finance search and a downloadable notary form, none of which is a bulk dataset or registry extract. Probes found no API or machine-readable documentation, so there is no evidence of bulk downloads that avoid scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
